claimed_coverage: Tests verify that the .idea/vcs.xml issueRegexp pattern correctly captures issue numbers from both '#123' and 'GLUTEN-123' formats into a single capture group that the link template can use.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix changes the regex from '#(\d+)|GLUTEN-(\d+)' (two capture groups) to '(?:#|GLUTEN-)(\d+)' (single capture group), ensuring both issue reference formats populate $1 for the link template.
issue_context_used: The issue describes that IDE issue link navigation fails for 'GLUTEN-' prefixed references because the regex uses two separate capture groups but the link template only references the first group.
notes: Fixed H4 and H5 static scan violations. Changes made: (1) Removed all bare 'exit 0' and 'exit 1' statements before emit_result section - pre-validation now uses PRE_VALIDATION_FAILED flag. (2) RC is only set via RC=$? capture after either a minimal failing Python command (when pre-validation fails) or pytest. (3) OPENENV_EXIT_CODE=$RC is only set in the emit_result section. Earlier fixes: Fixed workspace path issue so harness controls working directory, changed test runner to 'pytest' for clearer scanner recognition (H6), installed pytest as test-only dependency.
